cases.input: Turn a biomarker evidence note into a chapter for educated non-scientists.
requiredBehaviors: build an audience and explanation model before drafting
run lay reader workshop and final fidelity recheck
forbiddenBehaviors: invent stronger scientific claims for drama
approve an easy-to-read explanation that reconstructs the science incorrectly
skillAnchors: Jede Analogie braucht eine dokumentierte Bruchkante

cases.input: A memorable analogy is useful but can imply a false one-to-one biological mechanism.
requiredBehaviors: record where the analogy breaks down
revise or qualify the analogy when misconception risk is material
forbiddenBehaviors: keep a misleading analogy solely because it is vivid

cases.input: The draft turns a correlational study into a causal claim to create a stronger ending.
requiredBehaviors: detect claim drift in the fidelity recheck
skillAnchors: Bei Claim Drift zurück in Revision
